data.name: Aisiah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘As-Saa-‘iha’ which means ‘helpful’ or ‘supportive’. This name is mentioned in the Quran in the story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) and his brothers. When Yusuf was sold into slavery in Egypt, he met two women who provided him with food and shelter. These women were called ‘As-Saa-‘ihaatain’, meaning ‘the two helpers’. Thus, Aisiah is a name of great significance, emphasizing the importance of kindness, generosity, and support towards others.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes kindness, generosity, and support towards others.

Those with the name Aisiah are also strong-willed and determined, making them excellent leaders and problem solvers.
